assessmentContext: The current apprenticeship uses an observed practical assessment with questions. Evia provides preparation and rehearsal, not an official assessment result.
sourceNote: Original Evia practice tasks mapped to course criteria. These are not official awarding-body or end-point-assessment tasks and do not produce an official grade.

decision.prompt: A checkpoint reveals that the opening is moving out of square. What is the strongest response?
options: Pause at a safe point, correct the cause of the opening is moving out of square, then repeat the specified checks before continuing.
Continue and hide the issue during finishing.
Change the drawing or specification to match the work.
Leave it for the next trade without recording it.
decision.feedback: Stop at a safe point, find the cause, correct the affected work and recheck before continuing.

commonFaults: the opening is moving out of square
mortar droppings are bridging the cavity
a tie or tray will be concealed before inspection

questions.prompt: Why is “Set out the wall, return and opening” important on this task?

questions.prompt: How would you check that this work meets the drawing or specification?
questions.guide: Check datums, diagonals, gauge, line, level, plumb and component positions against the drawing.

questions.prompt: What would you do if the opening is moving out of square?
questions.guide: Stop at a safe point, find the cause, correct the affected work and recheck before continuing.

decision.prompt: A checkpoint reveals that the tray falls toward the inner leaf. What is the strongest response?
options: Pause at a safe point, correct the cause of the tray falls toward the inner leaf, then repeat the specified checks before continuing.
Continue and hide the issue during finishing.
Change the drawing or specification to match the work.

questions.prompt: What would you do if the tray falls toward the inner leaf?
